headline: How To Get Waleetle
title: Waleetle | Where to find it and evolve | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Want Waleetle in Aniimo? Head to Berylline Vale. Waleetle stands a short walk south of the Mudstone Pass Bloom, close to Baleetle. They look alike from far away, so check the nameplate before you throw. You can also evolve a Baleetle. Raise it to level thirty nine, spend a Loam Stone, and meet the unlock shown in the evolution panel. Which Earth Aniimo do you use? Comment below!
description: Aniimo: find Waleetle in Berylline Vale south of the Mudstone Pass Bloom, or evolve Baleetle at level 39 with a Loam Stone.
